title: Reduce Completed select row export
summary: Removed the transitional Completed select-row flat window export while preserving the mediaPipelineCompletedView namespace helper and updating cross-page, diagnostics, and smoke consumers to use that namespace.
reason: The active WebView cleanup workstream calls for opportunistic removal of transitional flat window.* exports by touched domain while keeping namespace-first access guarded by static and browser evidence.
behavior_before: completedView.js exported both window.renderCompleted and window.selectCompletedRow as direct compatibility aliases. Cross-page sample/conflict navigation, diagnostics owner handoff, and affected smoke snippets still reached Completed row selection through the flat selectCompletedRow alias.
behavior_after: completedView.js keeps renderCompleted as the remaining flat compatibility alias and exposes selectCompletedRow only through window.mediaPipelineCompletedView. Cross-page sample/conflict navigation, diagnostics owner handoff, and affected smoke snippets call the namespace helper.
manual_validation: .\apps\desktop\runtime\Python\python.exe -B -m unittest tests.webview.test_webview_browser_high_risk_smoke tests.webview.test_webview_browser_diagnostics_handoff_smoke tests.webview.test_webview_browser_completed_pending_proof_smoke.WebViewBrowserCompletedPendingProofSmoke.test_real_browser_renders_completed_pending_proof_overlap_and_missing_output_detail -q (pass; 5 tests; existing malformed ActiveJobs fixture warnings printed by the diagnostics smoke)

.\apps\desktop\runtime\Python\python.exe -B -m unittest tests.webview.test_webview_browser_large_table_smoke -q (failed twice on pre-existing Queue detail keyboard-shortcut visibility: queue-detail had expected text but display none, before the Completed namespace selection assertion)
rg -n "window\.selectCompletedRow\s*=" apps/desktop/webview/static/assets Docs --glob '!Docs/generated/summaries/**' (pass; no matches, exit 1)
rollback_plan: Restore window.selectCompletedRow = selectCompletedRow in completedView.js, move cross-page/diagnostics/browser smoke consumers back to the flat alias, remove the served-source flat-assignment guard for selectCompletedRow, rerun npm run webview:contract, restore WebView flat-export counts to 498 and completedView.js to 2, refresh summaries/project index, and rerun the same WebView static/browser validation ladder.
notes:
Retired Completed select-row flat alias while preserving namespace access and updating WebView evidence.
Source-media safety: this is a frontend compatibility-export cleanup only. It does not change backend routes, strict confirmations, repair/reconcile apply behavior, pending-publish manifests, drain behavior, filesystem mutation, source/scratch/output handling, FFmpeg arguments, or media policy.
Downloads/real-media validation: no downloads were needed and no real-media validation is required for this WebView namespace cleanup.
Python impact: test-only Python updates; no Python runtime implementation changed.
Regenerated project navigation and packet summary for this change.
